The **[Casper Dream](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462852413314598,imageDocid:10350802822383359221,gpcid:1691439048477469109,headlineOfferDocid:6016895066321890070,catalogid:15316110495117565205,productDocid:11308339236745662392,rds:PC_1691439048477469109%7CPROD_PC_1691439048477469109&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiHxqi664OYAxWwSfEDHT2XL_oQxa4PeggIAggBCAwQAQ)** is a balanced, responsive **hybrid mattress** designed to blend a springy, active feel with ergonomic support.[[1]](https://casper.com/products/casper-dream-hybrid)[[2]](https://naplab.com/mattress-reviews/casper-dream-review/)

### **At a Glance** 

- **Type:** 11.5" to 12" Hybrid (Poly foam, memory foam, and pocketed coils)
- **Firmness:** Medium-firm (~6/10)
- **Queen Price:** ~$1,395 – $1,495 (frequently fluctuates with sales on [Casper](https://casper.com/products/casper-dream-hybrid))
- **Trial & Warranty:** 100-night risk-free trial + 10-year limited warranty
- **Construction:** Fiberglass-free with a Rayon fire barrier[[1]](https://naplab.com/mattress-reviews/casper-dream-review/)[[2]](https://casper.com/products/casper-dream-hybrid)

### **Construction & Layers** 

1. **Comfort Layer (3.0"):** Combines breathable poly foam and contouring memory foam for immediate step-in softness and pressure relief.
2. **Support & Ergonomic Layers:** Features Casper's signature **Zoned Support** (softer under the shoulders, firmer under the hips and lower back) to keep your spine aligned.
3. **Coil Base:** Pocketed flex coils paired with reinforced edge support foam to prevent sagging near the perimeter.[[1]](https://casper.com/products/casper-dream-hybrid)[[2]](https://naplab.com/mattress-reviews/casper-dream-review/)

### **Performance Breakdown** 

- **Cooling (9.0/10):** Open-cell foams and the hybrid coil structure allow strong airflow, keeping you neutral-to-cool through the night according to testing on [NapLab](https://naplab.com/mattress-reviews/casper-dream-review/).[[1]](https://naplab.com/mattress-reviews/casper-dream-review/)
- **Bounce & Response (High):** Unlike deep-sink memory foam beds, the [Casper Dream](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462852413314598,imageDocid:10350802822383359221,gpcid:1691439048477469109,headlineOfferDocid:6016895066321890070,catalogid:15316110495117565205,productDocid:11308339236745662392,rds:PC_1691439048477469109%7CPROD_PC_1691439048477469109&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiHxqi664OYAxWwSfEDHT2XL_oQxa4PeggIAggBCBwQBw) has an active, springy pushback, making it easy to change positions.[[1]](https://naplab.com/mattress-reviews/casper-dream-review/)
- **Motion Isolation (Good - 8.0/10):** Absorbs most movement, though you will feel slightly more bounce than you would on an all-foam bed.[[1]](https://naplab.com/mattress-reviews/casper-dream-review/)
- **Edge Support (8.9/10):** Reinforced perimeter foam means you can sleep or sit near the very edge without rolling off.[[1]](https://naplab.com/mattress-reviews/casper-dream-review/)

### **Pros & Cons** 

**Pros** 

- **Great for all sleeping positions:** The 6/10 medium-firm feel hits a sweet spot for back, side, and combo sleepers.
- **Zoned lumbar support:** Helps alleviate or prevent lower back tension.
- **Responsive bounce:** Ideal for people who dislike feeling "stuck" in slow-melting memory foam.
- **Fiberglass-free design:** Uses a safer Rayon fire barrier.[[1]](https://casper.com/products/casper-dream-hybrid)[[2]](https://naplab.com/mattress-reviews/casper-dream-review/)

**Cons** 

- **Price point:** Slightly higher than the general market average for a standard queen hybrid.
- **Minimal deep sinkage:** If you love a ultra-plush, cloud-like hugging sensation, you might prefer the softer *[Casper Dream Max](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462567973111070,imageDocid:17423674934256905709,gpcid:1882113148586177132,headlineOfferDocid:4533772873736962924,catalogid:15302482400248658712,productDocid:3882011513217719194,rds:PC_1882113148586177132%7CPROD_PC_1882113148586177132&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiHxqi664OYAxWwSfEDHT2XL_oQxa4PeggIAggBCCcQBA) *.[[1]](https://casper.com/products/casper-dream-hybrid)[[2]](https://naplab.com/mattress-reviews/casper-dream-review/)
